description: This file defines the PersonNameSaveHandler class, which implements the SaveHandler interface for PersonName objects. Its main function is to trim leading and trailing whitespace from the name attributes of PersonName instances before saving.

classes.name: PersonNameSaveHandler
classes.description: A handler class that trims whitespace from name attributes of PersonName objects before they are saved.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the givenName, middleName, familyName, and familyName2 attributes of a PersonName instance before saving.
